## Mission Statement

Azone Projects empowers students and businesses across the UAE and GCC with world-class academic consulting, precision web engineering, creative design, and digital growth strategies. We are committed to on-time delivery, zero plagiarism in academic work, and measurable outcomes in digital projects.

## Academic Writing Services (Full Detail)

### 1. Essay Writing
- **URL:** https://azoneprojects.com/services/essay-writing
- **Target Audience:** Undergraduate, Master's, and PhD students in UAE universities
- **Pricing:** Starting AED 30/page (Undergraduate)
- **Delivery:** As fast as 6 hours for urgent orders. Standard 3–5 days.
- **Guarantee:** 100% original, Turnitin plagiarism report included, free revisions within 14 days
- **Citation Styles:** APA, Harvard, MLA, Chicago, IEEE, and any institution-specific format
- **Universities Covered:** UOWD, AUS, Zayed University, Heriot-Watt Dubai, Middlesex University Dubai, Abu Dhabi University, University of Sharjah
- **Key Keywords:** essay writing UAE, essay writing Dubai, essay help Sharjah, academic essay service Abu Dhabi, plagiarism-free essays UAE

### 2. Dissertation Help
- **URL:** https://azoneprojects.com/services/dissertation-help
- **Scope:** Full dissertations or individual chapters — proposal, literature review, methodology, data analysis, results, conclusion
- **Support:** SPSS, NVivo, JASP, R, Stata, and Excel for quantitative and qualitative analysis
- **Pricing:** Starting AED 40/page
- **Free Additions:** Turnitin report, dedicated project manager, bibliography
- **Key Keywords:** dissertation help UAE, dissertation writing Dubai, PhD dissertation Sharjah, dissertation chapters Abu Dhabi, literature review UAE

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Is your academic writing service confidential?**
A: Yes, complete confidentiality is guaranteed. We never share client information with third parties.

**Q: Do you guarantee plagiarism-free work?**
A: Every academic order includes a free Turnitin plagiarism report confirming 0% plagiarism.

**Q: Which UAE universities do you support?**
A: We support all accredited UAE universities including UOWD, AUS, Heriot-Watt Dubai, Middlesex University Dubai, Abu Dhabi University, University of Sharjah, Zayed University, Murdoch University Dubai, SP Jain School of Global Management, and Amity University Dubai.

**Q: How fast can you deliver?**
A: Urgent orders can be delivered in as little as 6 hours. Standard turnaround is 3–5 days.

**Q: What payment methods do you accept?**
A: We accept bank transfer, cash, and digital payment methods. All prices are in AED.

**Q: Do you help with data analysis tools like SPSS or NVivo?**
A: Yes, our team includes statisticians proficient in SPSS, NVivo, JASP, R, Stata, and Excel.
